prompt:
solution.py is meant to implement the specification below, but it contains several defects. One has been reported: `render("{v|upper|lower}", {"v": "Ab"})` returns "AB" instead of "ab". Fix that and every other deviation from the specification. Keep the public names and signatures unchanged and do not change behaviour the specification requires.

Specification: Implement `render(template, values)` in solution.py and return a string. A placeholder `{name}` is replaced by str() of `values[name]`. A dotted name such as `{user.name}` walks nested dicts. `{{` and `}}` produce a literal `{` and `}`. Filters follow the name after a `|` and are applied left to right to the string value: `upper`, `lower`, `title` (str.title) and `trim` (strip surrounding whitespace), as in `{name|trim|upper}`. Whitespace around the name and around filter names is ignored (`{ name | upper }`). Each segment of a name consists of letters, digits and underscores and must not be empty. Raise KeyError when a name segment is missing or when a value that must be walked into is not a dict. Raise ValueError for an unknown filter, an empty filter, an empty placeholder, a malformed name, a `{` without a closing `}`, and a lone `}` outside a placeholder. Text outside placeholders is copied unchanged.
acceptance: a lone closing brace is an error
walking into a non-dict raises KeyError
whitespace inside a placeholder is ignored
